cactus-compute/needle.description: 14MB foundation model for tiny devices; phones, wearables, smart home, and robots.
score_reasons: topics: cactus, gemini, gemma, llm, on-device-ai
cactus-compute/needle.readme_summary: Needle 2 is an open 45M-parameter model for tool calling, device use and structured extraction. The whole model is a single 14MB binary that runs a full session in about 28MB of RAM. It is built on our Simple Attention Network findings, compressed to CQ2-bit with Cactus Quants, and baked into its own engine. On the benchmarks below, Needle 2 trades wins with other small models like FunctionGemma 270M, LFM2.5 230M and Apple FM, at 5x to 70x smaller, and 2 bits against their f16.

analysis.positioning: Needle 是一个面向微型设备（如手机、可穿戴设备、智能家居和机器人）的开源基础模型，以14MB的二进制文件提供45M参数的模型，支持工具调用、设备使用和结构化提取。与普通同类工具相比，其显著特点是体积极小（比同类小5到70倍），且以2比特量化运行，内存占用约28MB，适合在资源受限的边缘设备上部署。

akitaonrails/ai-memory.description: Solution for long term memory for agent coding CLIs and to facilitate handoff between different agent vendors
akitaonrails/ai-memory.readme_summary: LLM coding agents lose context when a session ends. ai-memory gives them a shared, persistent wiki compiled from sanitized lifecycle observations. When a session ends, relevant observations become a coherent summary; the next agent receives a bounded handoff. Optional `ai-memory run` launches add a portable visible-event ledger and native per-harness resume for higher-fidelity

analysis.positioning: ai-memory 是一个为 LLM 编码代理提供长期记忆的解决方案，解决代理在会话结束后丢失上下文的问题。它通过将清理后的生命周期观察编译成共享的持久化 wiki，并在会话结束时生成连贯摘要，为下一个代理提供有界的交接。与普通工具相比，其明确特点是跨代理供应商的交接支持，以及可选的可见事件账本和原生恢复功能。
target_users: 使用 LLM 编码代理的开发者，需要在会话间保持上下文连续性
